metadata.name: Product Comparison Report
metadata.description: Research cloud providers and generate an interactive comparison table
metadata.author: user

goals.objective: Research the top 3 cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and gather pricing and feature information for compute services

success: Information gathered for AWS EC2, Azure VMs, and GCP Compute Engine
Pricing tiers documented for each provider
acceptance: Data is structured and ready for comparison

constraints: Include at least 3 pricing tiers per provider

goals.objective: Create an interactive HTML comparison table showing cloud provider features, pricing, and recommendations

success: HTML table generated with all provider data
Table can be exported to CSV
Data is clearly organized and readable
acceptance: Table renders correctly in a web browser
All comparison data is accurately displayed

constraints: Use the tablemaker tool to generate the table
Include columns for: Provider, Tier, vCPUs, RAM, Storage, Price/Hour, Best For
